body:
Black Friday is a good time to compare prices on tools you already use for client work, from Adobe subscriptions to the hardware on your desk.

This guide covers Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals for graphic designers in 2026, with a separate Amazon watchlist for the display, book, swatch guide, mouse and tablet pictured on the cover.

Updated November 23, 2026 with 63 offers, including upcoming sales with their start dates. Black Friday is November 27 and Cyber Monday is November 30.

Some links are affiliate links, and Ebaq Design may earn a commission if you buy through them.

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.

For identity work, start with Logo Package’s Illustrator extensions and Hazard’s mockup library. For a website project, compare component licenses, hosting renewal prices, and how many client sites each plan covers.

  • Mockups, fonts, illustration and print
  • Web design, templates and hosting
  • Image, video, audio and presentation tools
  • Drawing tablets, cameras and studio equipment
  • Design courses and education
  • Amazon hardware and books to watch

Top Black Friday deals for designers

Start here for current discounts on design software, creative assets and website tools.

1. Adobe Creative Cloud Pro

Eligible first-time U.S. individual subscribers can save 57% for the first year: $29.99 per month on an annual plan billed monthly.

The 12-month plan renews at the then-current price, currently $69.99 per month; the offer ends November 27.

Students and teachers can also qualify for $15.99 per month for the first year, and eligible teams can pay $44.99 per license per month for the first year.

See our full Adobe Black Friday guide for eligibility and renewal details, or compare plans.

2. Adobe Firefly

Adobe lists up to 60% off Firefly Pro or Pro Plus for the first six months.

In the U.S., Firefly Pro starts at $8.49/month and Pro Plus at $16.79/month on annual plans billed monthly for the first six months.

The standalone Firefly offer ends December 6, later than the November 27 Creative Cloud deadline. See Adobe’s Firefly terms for eligibility and regular rates.

3. ElevenLabs ElevenCreative

ElevenLabs says eligible subscribers can save up to 55% on annual Creator and Pro plans from November 16 to December 1.

Creator is $99 for the year. New Pro subscribers get 55% off their annual plan, and existing monthly Pro subscribers get 50% off when switching to annual.

For designers producing a narrated case study or demo video, compare the audio credits you need with the annual commitment.

View ElevenLabs plans or read the official promotion announcement.

4. Topaz Labs

Topaz lists up to 67% off app bundles and 15% off single apps for its Black Friday sale.

For example, its AI Creator bundle is listed at $199 for a year, compared with $599; the bundle focuses on web and mobile image and video upscaling.

See Topaz’s sale page for the current price, plan features and conditions; the checkout shows the price for your selected bundle. You can also browse Topaz apps.

5. ls.graphics

Mockup and design resource maker ls.graphics says its Black Friday offer is 50% off through December 1.

Check the maker’s announcement and individual license terms before purchasing assets for client work.

6. Shadcnblocks

40% off with code SHADCNBLOCKSFRI40.

Shadcnblocks says the sale runs through November 30 and covers its React blocks and templates.

Check which plan covers the blocks, Figma files or templates you need before buying.

Check the Shadcnblocks offer.

7. Cloudways

80% off the first two months with code BFCM802.

The offer runs November 5 to December 4 and is capped at $200 off per month.

Compare the third-month bill and any add-ons against the cost of keeping your existing host.

Check the Cloudways offer.

8. Teachable

50% off the first two months.

Teachable advertised half price for the first two months on eligible plans in its Black Friday email.

Check the plan at checkout and compare its standard monthly price and transaction fees if you are launching a design course.

Compare Teachable plans and check the promotion before paying.

9. TNCFlow

30% off templates with code BFTMPL2026.

The sale runs November 20 to December 5 and includes listed Webflow, Framer, Figma and other templates.

Check what files are included and whether the template license fits your client project.

Check the TNCFlow offer.

10. Crocoblock

50% off its final batch of Lifetime licenses.

Crocoblock announced $499.50 instead of $999 from November 27 through December 4, or until the 600 licenses sell out.

Consider it if you already use JetPlugins across multiple client WordPress projects.

Check the Crocoblock offer.

11. Porkbun

First-year discounts on selected domains.

Porkbun lists sale prices by domain extension, including .art and .shop.

Compare the renewal price and check whether the offer applies to new registrations or transfers before moving a client domain.

Check the Porkbun offer.

12. Recraft

Recraft offers 40% off the first year of a new yearly plan through December 1 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific.

Plans start at $72 billed annually, equivalent to $6 per month during the introductory year.

The offer excludes active yearly subscribers, varies by country and renews at the regular rate.

Explore Recraft or check the Black Friday pricing and eligibility.

13. pen.dev (formerly Pencil)

In its November 23 email, pen.dev advertised an extra 25% off annual Pro and Ultra plans for the first year when chosen by the end of November 27, Pacific time.

Pro works out to $12 per month ($144 billed annually), and Ultra to $36 per month ($432 billed annually).

The promotion email includes a checkout code. Check that the reduced first-year total appears before paying. See pen.dev plans.

14. MyFonts

Variable Type Foundry’s Black Friday sale takes 30% off selected typefaces, including VTF Justina, Rozanova and VTF Ruth, through November 30.

Choose the desktop or web license your client actually needs before comparing prices.

Browse MyFonts or see the foundry-specific promotions.

15. ScoreApp

For studios building a brand assessment or client intake quiz, ScoreApp offers 50% off the first year of an eligible annual plan plus a place in its January campaign bootcamp.

The offer runs November 23 through December 1. Explore ScoreApp or read the offer and bootcamp details.

Mockups, fonts, illustration and print

16. Hazard Mockups

Hazard is closing its shop on December 31, 2026.

Its complete collection of 423 photography-based mockups starts at €49 before VAT for the one-person license.

The catalogue includes PSD and After Effects files for presenting packaging, signage and other identity work. Choose the license for your team size and advertising needs, and download the files by June 30, 2027.

Shop Hazard Mockups · Official offer details

17. Logo Package Express

Logo Package’s Black Friday email offers 40% off its Illustrator extensions with code bfm26 from Black Friday through Cyber Monday, November 27–30.

Logo Package Express exports organized client handoff files from Adobe Illustrator. The vendor lists the extension at $149 before the promotion.

Explore the Illustrator extensions

18. Pacdora

Use BFCM35 for 35% off the first year of an annual plan through November 30.

Pro is $129 for the first year and then $199 per seat per year, with personal-use rights. Business includes commercial use and resale rights and costs $460 for the first year, then $708 per seat per year.

Official offer details

19. Artboard Studio

Pay $49 once, down from $129, for lifetime access to more than 5,000 mockups, 3D device scenes, video export and the Figma and Adobe Express plugins.

The offer ends December 5, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. UTC.

Shop Artboard Studio · Official offer details

20. Yellow Images

Yellow Images offers 50% off its mockup memberships.

Its monthly option is listed at $29.50, down from $59, and its annual option at $16.63 per month billed annually.

Shop Yellow Images · Official offer details

21. RetroSupply

RetroSupply takes 50% off every digital product in the cart through November 30 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific.

The complete collection for Procreate, Photoshop, Illustrator or Affinity is $98.50 per app, down from $197. The Clip Studio Paint collection is $74.50, down from $149.

Official offer details

22. CorelDRAW

Corel’s U.S. Black Friday Countdown puts CorelDRAW Graphics Suite at $159 for the first year of an annual subscription, down from $269.

The Mac one-time purchase is $329, down from $549. CorelDRAW Go, the browser-based editor, is $49.99 for its first year, down from $99.99.

Official offer details

23. Alamy

Use SUBSBF50 for 50% off the first 12 months of an Alamy Open stock subscription.

The code applies to monthly plans.

Shop Alamy · Official offer details

24. Magnific (formerly Freepik)

Magnific offers up to 62% off annual plans with gift credits, and up to 40% off Business plans for teams of three or more.

Premium is $87 for the first year and then $174 annually. The offer covers new purchases and switches from monthly to annual billing, and ends December 1 at 8 a.m. Central European Time.

Shop Magnific (formerly Freepik) · Official offer details

25. VistaPrint

VistaPrint’s U.S. sale takes up to 50% off hundreds of products and up to 60% off select holiday cards and wall calendars through December 1.

The discount applies automatically in the cart. See the VistaPrint sale.

26. Custom Ink

Custom Ink advertises up to 25% off for Black Friday on its U.S. storefront, with sale prices marked on products.

Official offer details

27. Cutout.Pro

Cutout.Pro advertises at least 60% off its previous prices on subscriptions and pay-as-you-go credits for its image and video tools.

Official offer details

Web design, templates and hosting

28. shadcncraft

The Figma and React component library is 40% off through December 1, including its Figma bundles.

Shop shadcncraft or compare licenses.

29. UiChemy

UiChemy’s Figma-to-WordPress plans show up to 30% off the first payment depending on the plan and billing option, with selected plans also getting more Figma seats and site projects.

Compare the Black Friday plans.

30. TemplateMonster

TemplateMonster marks select WordPress themes 10% off for Black Friday.

Examples include the Arkion architecture theme at $44, down from $49, and Hazel at $80, down from $89.

Official offer details

31. Semflow

Semflow’s SEO and AI visibility tools for Webflow and Framer are on sale.

Pro costs $14 per month with monthly billing, down from $29, or $120 for a year. Semflow says you keep the promotional rate while the subscription stays active. Explore Semflow or compare billing options.

32. Paperform

New Pro and Business subscriptions get 50% off the first 12 months with PFBF26 through November 30, Pacific time.

Try Paperform or read the offer terms.

33. Appy Pie

Appy Pie’s app-builder pricing page offers 25% off with BLACKFRIDAY25.

Explore the app builder or check eligible plans.

34. Hostinger

Hostinger advertises up to 85% off eligible hosting plans.

Premium hosting at $1.99 per month requires $95.52 upfront for 48 months, and the advertised renewal is $10.99 per month. Compare the term and renewal price.

35. SiteGround

SiteGround’s StartUp web hosting is advertised at $1.99 per month for a prepaid year.

It renews at $17.99 per month prepaid for 12 months, a significant difference when quoting a client’s ongoing site costs.

Explore SiteGround or compare introductory and renewal rates.

36. Namecheap

New domain registrations include .com for $8.98 for the first year with THEGAMESTLD26.

The sale ends December 4 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern, with up to five domain registrations per business or household. Find a domain or check the eligible extensions.

37. Pixpa

For a portfolio website, Pixpa’s sale starts November 28.

Use BLFPIXPA55 for up to 55% off annual plans through December 31. See Pixpa’s offer.

38. Scalenut

For studios producing search content alongside client websites, Scalenut advertises 65% off annual plans with triple usage limits.

Explore Scalenut or check its Black Friday plan details.

Image, video, audio and presentation tools

39. Skylum Luminar

New Luminar customers can save up to 77% on the photo editor through November 30.

Existing owners can check their upgrade pricing separately.

See Luminar plans or read Skylum’s announcement.

40. Dzine

For AI image and video work, new customers and current monthly subscribers switching to an individual annual plan can use BF40 for 40% off the first year.

Master is $360 for the first year and renews at the regular annual price. Explore Dzine or compare the sale plans.

41. Logo Diffusion

Logo Diffusion offers 20% off monthly plans or 33% off annual plans for Black Friday.

The monthly Basic plan displays $19 a month for the first three months, then $24 per month. Compare the annual total if you expect to generate logo concepts throughout the year.

Shop Logo Diffusion · Official offer details

42. Mubert

Mubert offers up to 50% off the first year of its Creator, Pro and Ultra music plans.

Check the license for the campaign or client you plan to use the music for.

Compare Mubert’s licenses or see its November 17 sale announcement.

43. Pictory

Pictory’s pricing page advertises 50% off its video creation plans.

Compare the included video minutes against the lengths of the explainers or product demos you need to deliver.

Explore Pictory or check the sale price for your plan.

44. Pixara AI

Pixara lists up to 70% off yearly image and video generation plans.

Compare the included credits against your expected production volume before choosing a tier. Compare Pixara’s sale prices.

45. Genspark

Genspark’s U.S. offer takes 50% off the first year of eligible annual plans through December 1 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. For designers building presentations in AI Slides, Plus works out to $9.99 per month when billed annually. Check Genspark’s plans.

46. Decktopus

Decktopus is offering 66% off annual plans for its presentation builder.

Enter BF26 at checkout by December 11.

Explore Decktopus or check the offer on its homepage.

47. Riverside

Riverside’s subscriber offer gives creators 35% off when switching to annual billing with code BF26 through November 27.

Check that the discount appears on your annual total before switching.

View Riverside recording plans.

48. LALAL.AI

For cleaning up a recorded interview or separating music stems, LALAL.AI’s annual Pro plan costs $108 for the first year through December 4.

It renews at $180.

If you have a single batch of recordings, the 3,000-minute pack is $114 as a one-time purchase. Explore LALAL.AI or read its sale terms.

49. FlexClip

FlexClip advertises 40% off its video editor plans with code FCVEBF.

If you’re buying it for client videos, check the export resolution and stock allowances on the plan you select.

Explore FlexClip or check the official sale banner.

50. Synthesia

Synthesia’s video-avatar promotion is open to new customers and free users upgrading to paid.

The pricing page advertises Pro from $19 for the first month, with different offers by credit allowance and billing term.

The purchase must be paid by December 7 at 7:59 a.m. GMT. Explore Synthesia or review the offer for your plan.

51. Transistor

Podcast hosting from Transistor is 20% off the first year when purchased annually through its Black Friday promotion.

Explore Transistor or open its Black Friday signup.

52. PromeAI

PromeAI will award 10% to 50% first-month cashback to 30 approved Canvas Challenge participants on Base or Standard monthly plans.

Only two participants can receive 50%. Eligibility requires a successful Canvas generation before the event. Pay November 27–30 UTC and submit the challenge before the deadline. Explore PromeAI and check eligibility and submission dates.

Drawing tablets, cameras and studio equipment

53. Huion

If you draw or retouch directly on a screen, Huion lists the 15.8-inch Kamvas 16 (Gen 3) for $419, down $80.

Its larger Kamvas Pro 19 is $799, down $300.

The sale runs through November 30. Compare Huion’s Black Friday pen displays.

54. XPPen

XPPen’s U.S. store highlights the Artist Pro 16 (Gen 2) at $449.99 as its Black Friday pick.

It pairs a 2.5K pen display with a pressure-sensitive stylus for illustration or retouching.

Check XPPen’s current U.S. price.

55. Insta360

Insta360 lists 20% off the X5 camera and the Flow 2 Pro smartphone gimbal in its U.S. Black Friday guide. The gimbal is the smaller purchase for someone filming studio walkthroughs with an existing phone.

Compare the Black Friday and Cyber Monday models.

56. HOVERAir

The HOVERAir U.S. store advertises up to 20% off during its November 17–30 sale on self-flying cameras.

Compare the camera-only price with the kit if you need additional batteries on a shoot.

See HOVERAir’s U.S. sale.

57. FlexiSpot

FlexiSpot’s E7 desk promotion runs through November 24.

A separate sale runs November 26–29 with up to 50% off eligible sitewide items. Its schedule gives November 30 its own offer of 15% off qualifying orders of $500 or more.

Some coupons have limited redemptions. Check FlexiSpot’s dated offer schedule.

58. OdinLake

OdinLake lists the L3 desk chair from $299, down from $349, during its November 1–December 1 event.

Configuration and footrest options can change the total.

See OdinLake’s Black Friday configurations.

Design courses and education

59. Flux Academy

The AI Web Design Collection costs $497 paid in full through November 30, with lifetime access to ten trainings.

Three payments of $175 bring the total to $525. Compare the payment options at Flux Academy.

60. Coursera Plus

Coursera advertises $239 for a year of Coursera Plus in its U.S. Black Friday promotion. Check that the specific design course or certificate you want is included before buying the annual subscription.

See Coursera’s current Black Friday offer.

61. edX

Use CYBERMONTH2026 for 15% off selected courses and programs through November 26 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern. Eligible purchases include verified courses and Professional Certificates. Degree programs are excluded.

Review the edX Cyber Month eligibility rules.

62. MasterClass Certificates

MasterClass offers 50% off eligible certificate products bought directly through its website before November 25 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Each purchase grants one year of access to the associated course material.

Read the MasterClass certificate offer terms.

63. Kajabi

Designers selling their own courses can get 30% off the first six months of a Kajabi plan through November 30 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Choosing the discounted plan starts paid service immediately.

Compare Kajabi plans or review its Black Friday offer.

Amazon hardware and books to watch

These are products from the previous guide worth comparing during the sale.

Amazon prices and availability can change. Check the exact configuration and the live listing for any discount.

Apple Studio Display

A 27-inch 5K display is worth comparing if you spend most of your day in Figma, Illustrator or InDesign on a Mac.

Compare the stand and glass options on the exact listing, since the price can change considerably between configurations.

Check Apple Studio Display on Amazon.

Logitech MX Master 3S

This mouse is useful for switching between devices and scrolling across wide canvases and timelines.

Check the color and connectivity bundle before comparing prices across listings.

Check Logitech MX Master 3S on Amazon.

Pantone Formula Guide

The coated and uncoated swatch fans let you compare physical spot-color references when you hand off packaging or print work.

Check the edition and included guides before ordering, especially if you need to match a printer’s reference set.

Check Pantone Formula Guide on Amazon.

Wacom Intuos Pro

A screenless pen tablet is a practical upgrade for sketching marks, retouching images or working with pressure-sensitive brushes.

Match the active area to your desk and confirm the size and generation on the listing.

Check Wacom Intuos Pro on Amazon.

Logo Modernism by Jens Müller

This TASCHEN reference collects thousands of modernist marks, with examples organized by form and visual approach.

Check the title and edition, since the search results also include other books in the same series.

Check Logo Modernism by Jens Müller on Amazon.

MacBook Pro with M4 Pro

Compare MacBook Pro configurations if your current machine struggles with motion work, large files or multiple creative apps.

Match memory, storage and chip before judging an older model against the price of a newer one.

Check MacBook Pro with M4 Pro on Amazon.

Logitech MX Mechanical

A mechanical keyboard can make sense if it will live on your desk through long production days.

Check switch type and keyboard layout, particularly if you switch between macOS and Windows.

Check Logitech MX Mechanical on Amazon.

Shortcut keyboard cover

A printed shortcut overlay can help when learning a new tool or teaching common shortcuts.

Confirm the app, keyboard layout and laptop model match the listing.

Check Shortcut keyboard cover on Amazon.

Self-healing cutting mat

A cutting mat comes in handy for trimming print proofs, mockups and packaging prototypes.

Check the dimensions against your largest mockup and the amount of desk space you can spare.

Check Self-healing cutting mat on Amazon.

More places to check for Black Friday deals

The previous guide also covered these categories. Check each provider for a current offer and its terms before relying on a discount.

Courses

  • Udemy. Compare the actual course and its update history, since sale prices can vary by account and location.
  • Domestika. Check whether the checkout is for an individual class or starts a recurring Plus membership.
  • Skillshare. Check the trial length and annual charge before starting a membership.

Marketplaces and stock photos

  • Envato Elements. Compare the library and per-project licensing for mockups, presentation templates and fonts.
  • Adobe Stock. Match the plan to your licensing volume and check whether unused credits carry forward.
  • Shutterstock. Compare image packs with subscription pricing and confirm the license your client work needs.

Website builders and hosting

  • Framer says its Black Friday event starts November 27 at 9 a.m. Central European Time. Pricing had yet to be announced as of November 23.
  • Webflow. Check whether an offer applies to a template, a site plan or a workspace before you budget around it.
  • Squarespace. Compare the annual plan with the renewal price and any domain or commerce fees.
  • Shopify. Check plan and theme costs separately if you are budgeting an ecommerce launch.

Fonts, icons and design apps

  • MyFonts. Look up separate desktop, web and app rights for the typeface you actually need.
  • Iconfinder. Check whether your license covers use in client files and how attribution works.
  • IconScout. Review the specific license on icons, illustrations or 3D assets that will ship in a project.
  • Canva. Compare seats and brand features if you plan to hand an editable template system to a client.

Web apps, domains and services

  • FreshBooks. Compare client limits and what the plan costs after the introductory billing period.
  • Namecheap. Check the renewal price, transfer terms and any first-year registration limits.
  • Brand Master Bundle. Review the included brand strategy and presentation resources against the parts of your process you want to improve.

What is Black Friday?

Black Friday is the Friday after U.S. Thanksgiving, and many design software sales start earlier or extend through Cyber Monday.

For a studio, the useful deadline is the date the vendor actually gives you at checkout, especially if you are switching plans or waiting for a client to approve an expense.

How do I compare a subscription deal with a one-time purchase?

Write down the full cost over the next twelve months, including the regular rate after the promotion and any seats or credits your work requires.

For one-time assets, check whether updates, support and future client projects are included.

What should I compare when shopping for studio hardware?

Compare the same model, configuration and seller, then check returns and warranty coverage before ordering.

For a display or drawing tablet, measure the space it will actually occupy and confirm that it connects to the computer you use.

How to decide whether a deal is worth it

Start with tools you already use or need for a specific project, then calculate the cost after the introductory period.

Check the license for commercial use, the number of seats, credit allowances, taxes and any automatic renewal before checkout.

Black Friday falls on November 27 and Cyber Monday on November 30 in 2026, but each vendor sets its own dates.
